column1: # FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE, the Hong Kong release (0100B8A026F14000): the region variant of the JP release's build ([0100606026F12000](../0100606026F12000/game.tsv)) — the same engine
# (SDK MW+EpicGames+UnrealEngine-5_6_1 in main, UE 5.6.1, the desktop renderer, SF_GLSL_SWITCH shaders), the same sdk and subsdk0 builds (STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT's), the same shader libraries
# (73,496 shaders, every table of the JP profile's included here from this build's own files), and a main whose code through nninitStartup is byte-identical at every site that matters
# (the 62 GB default at main+0x137c0, the FMallocBinned3 constructor call at main+0x137f0, the object at main+0x77c6210, the pool base at main+0x7c148a0; its build ID differs, so every
# build-keyed registration needs this profile of its own: the cut, the allocator takeover in dm/host/hle_uemalloc.c, this memory layout).

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie, which main imports from; the sdk is STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT's build)
# The JP release's setting (same engine build and shader libraries): 60 fps (30 on the Switch) by the host's write of rhi.SyncInterval (hle_fpslock.c); DM_FPS_TARGET=30 keeps the game's 30
# The JP release's layout, verified on this build: the engine's page allocator never returns address space, so the region is capped at 4064 MB (game_args) in Engage's 5 GB block
# (256 MB in front + 4.375 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 128 MB heap region), and FMallocBinned3 runs on a host malloc zone (the constructor call cut, hle_uemalloc.c layout UE5_6).
# The NSP script's provisional profile kept the engine's raw 62 GB request, which a Mac reserves but the iPhone cannot (FATAL reserve guest AS at nnosInitialize)
# the NPDM declares 20 MB of system resource
# A 3D field whose camera the right stick tilts and turns: the 3D pad layout. It plays docked (1920x1080)
# 2,077 vertex shaders (Unreal's particle vertex factories) pick one of several c2 table slots at run time, as the JP release's (the same shader libraries)
# The two shader libraries of the IoStore container FFRS-Switch.utoc / .ucas: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders, as the JP release's
